description: One job from the ledger ({job}: state queued|running|done|failed|stopped, elapsed_s, result when finished), or your jobs (active[], finished[], paused) when job_id is omitted. op=stop {job_id} stops one run: queued, it never starts; running, it ends at its next turn. op=pause holds the runner (queued runs wait, a running one holds at its next turn); op=resume lets it go (write access).

job_id.description: The job to read or stop, e.g. J-0007.

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

name: library_job
